grammar.usage:
“越……越……”结构用于表示两个动作、状态或程度之间存在着同步变化的关系：一个方面增强或减弱，另一个方面也随之增强或减弱。其核心结构为“The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语”，前后两个分句通常用逗号隔开。比较级可以是形容词比较级（如 harder, better, more important），也可以是副词比较级（如 more quickly, more carefully），还可以是“more + 名词”结构（如 more money, more experience）。

肯定形式中，前后两个分句都使用比较级，表示“越……就越……”。例如：The more you read, the more you understand. 否定形式通常在分句中加入否定词，如：The less you worry, the better you will feel. 疑问形式较少直接使用，但在口语或书面语中可以通过疑问句来询问这种关系，如：Is it true that the more you practice, the better you get? 需要注意的是，该结构本身不是疑问句，而是陈述一种规律或趋势。

与近义结构对比：该结构与“as + 原级 + as”不同，后者表示同级比较，如“as fast as possible”并不表示“越快越好”的递进关系。与“more and more + 原级”也不同，“more and more”只表示单方面程度的持续增加，而“the more…, the more…”强调两个方面的联动变化。高中阶段还需要掌握省略形式，如“The sooner, the better.”（越快越好），这种省略主语和谓语的形式在口语和书面语中都很常见。

初中阶段主要要求学生掌握基本结构，能够识别和完成简单的句型转换，如将“If you study harder, you will get better grades.”改写为“The harder you study, the better grades you will get.”高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能够在写作中灵活运用该结构表达复杂逻辑关系；第二，能够识别并理解省略形式；第三，能够将“the more…, the more…”结构与名词性从句、定语从句等复合结构结合使用；第四，注意前后分句的时态和语序，尤其是当分句中含有情态动词或完成时态时。

易错点一：忘记在比较级前加“the”。例如误写为“More you read, more you know.”，正确形式应为“The more you read, the more you know.”。易错点二：前后分句都使用原级而非比较级。例如误写为“The hard you work, the good you get.”，正确形式应为“The harder you work, the better you get.”。易错点三：前后分句语序混乱，把主语和谓语的位置放错。例如误写为“The more you read, the more know you.”，正确形式应为“The more you read, the more you know.”。易错点四：在省略形式中误加主语或谓语，例如把“The sooner, the better.”写成“The sooner you do it, the better it is.”，虽然后者语法上不算错，但在固定表达中应使用省略形式。
forms: The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语（如：The harder you work, the more you achieve.）
The + more + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语, the + more + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语（如：The more books you read, the more knowledge you gain.）
The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形（如：The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.）
The + 比较级, the + 比较级（省略形式，如：The more, the better. / The sooner, the better.）
The + less + 主语 + 谓语, the + less + 主语 + 谓语（表示递减关系，如：The less you complain, the less stressed you feel.）
The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分（含从句或状语，如：The more languages a person learns, the more cultures he or she can experience.）
notes: 高考书面表达中，使用“the more…, the more…”结构可以提升句式的复杂度和逻辑性，但务必确保前后两个分句都使用比较级，且比较级前必须加“the”。
注意该结构与“more and more”的区别：前者表示两个方面的联动变化，后者只表示单方面程度的递增，不可混用。
在正式书面语中，前后分句的时态应保持一致或符合逻辑，例如前句用一般现在时，后句用一般将来时或情态动词结构，避免时态混乱。
省略形式“The sooner, the better.”等属于固定表达，在高考语法填空或短文改错中可能出现，需识别其省略了主语和谓语，不要误判为成分残缺。
当比较级为“more + 多音节形容词/副词”时，注意不要漏掉“more”，也不要将“the”与“more”的位置颠倒，正确语序为“the more + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语”。

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you will play.
examples.cn: 你练习得越多，你就会打得越好。

examples.en: The harder you study, the higher your grades will be.
examples.cn: 你学习越努力，你的成绩就会越高。

examples.en: The more friends you have, the happier you will feel.
examples.cn: 你拥有的朋友越多，你就会感到越快乐。

examples.en: The more carefully you plan, the less likely you are to make mistakes.
examples.cn: 你计划得越仔细，你就越不可能犯错。

examples.en: The more languages a person learns, the more deeply he or she can understand different cultures.
examples.cn: 一个人学习的语言越多，他或她就能越深入地理解不同的文化。

examples.en: The more independent a student becomes, the more effectively he or she can manage both academic and personal challenges.
examples.cn: 一个学生变得越独立，他或她就能越有效地应对学业和个人方面的挑战。

exercises.q: ______ you eat, ______ you will be.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都要用“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The ______ you run, the ______ you feel.
exercises.explain: 前半句用副词比较级，后半句用多音节形容词比较级。

exercises.q: The more water you drink, ______ you need to go to the toilet.
exercises.explain: 后半句同样需要“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: ______ you sleep, ______ you feel in the morning.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，且两处都要有 the。

exercises.q: The more you practice English, ______ it becomes.
exercises.explain: easy 的比较级是 easier，前面要加 the。

exercises.q: The ______ (much) you read, the more you know.
exercises.explain: much 的比较级是 more。

exercises.q: The earlier you get up, the ______ (good) you will feel.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better。

exercises.q: The more you smile, the ______ (happy) you are.
exercises.explain: happy 的比较级是 happier。

exercises.q: The more you eat, the more you want.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The more you study, the good your grades are.
exercises.explain: 后半句应使用比较级 better，而不是原级 good。

exercises.q: If you run fast, you will get tired quickly. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The faster you run, the more tired you will get.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you eat a lot, you will become fat. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more you eat, the fatter you will become.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you practice a lot, you will become good. (用 the more... the better... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more you practice, the better you will become.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: The more you read, the smart you become.
exercises.answer: The more you read, the smarter you become.
exercises.explain: 后半句要用比较级 smarter，而不是原级 smart。

exercises.q: The harder you work, the more success you will be.
exercises.answer: The harder you work, the more successful you will be.
exercises.explain: success 是名词，应改为形容词 successful 的比较级。

exercises.q: ______ you learn, ______ you realize how much you don't know.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都要用“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The ______ the city is, the ______ it is to find a job.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都要用比较级形式。

exercises.q: The more you exercise, ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: strong 的比较级是 stronger，前面要加 the。

exercises.q: ______ you speak, ______ your English will become.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，且两处都要有 the。

exercises.q: The ______ you are, the ______ mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: careful 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more careful；mistakes 是可数名词，用 fewer。

exercises.q: The ______ (long) you wait, the harder it becomes.
exercises.explain: long 的比较级是 longer。

exercises.q: The more you share, the ______ (much) you receive.
exercises.explain: much 的比较级是 more。

exercises.q: The ______ (early) you start, the sooner you finish.
exercises.explain: early 的比较级是 earlier。

exercises.q: The more you worry, the less you enjoy life.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the more you become confident.
exercises.explain: confident 是形容词，应改为 more confident。

exercises.q: If you study harder, you will get better grades. (用 the more... the better... 改写)
exercises.answer: The harder you study, the better grades you will get.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you save more money, you will be richer. (用 the more... the richer... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more money you save, the richer you will be.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you know more people, you have more chances. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more people you know, the more chances you have.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: The more you read, the more knowledge you get.
exercises.answer: The more you read, the more knowledge you gain.
exercises.explain: get 可以接受，但 gain 更正式；本题主要考查搭配，get 不算错，可改为 gain 更佳。

exercises.q: The more you eat junk food, the more unhealthy you become.
exercises.answer: The more junk food you eat, the unhealthier you become.
exercises.explain: unhealthy 的比较级是 unhealthier，且 junk food 位置应放在 eat 后面。

exercises.q: The more languages a person learns, ______ he or she has to experience new cultures.
exercises.explain: opportunity 是可数名词，用复数形式，且前面要加 the more。

exercises.q: ______ you understand the culture, ______ you will appreciate its values.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都要用“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The more you travel, ______ you become.
exercises.explain: open-minded 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more open-minded。

exercises.q: ______ you think about it, ______ it seems.
exercises.explain: complicated 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more complicated。

exercises.q: The more you practice speaking, ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: fluent 的比较级是 more fluent，前面要加 the。

exercises.q: The more you learn about other cultures, the ______ (broad) your perspective becomes.
exercises.explain: broad 的比较级是 broader。

exercises.q: The ______ (much) you understand, the less you judge.
exercises.explain: much 的比较级是 more。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ (confident) you become.
exercises.explain: confident 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more confident。

exercises.q: The more you learn, the more you realize how little you know.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The more you read, the more knowledge you will gain.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了“the + 比较级”结构。

exercises.q: If you learn more languages, you will experience more cultures. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more languages you learn, the more cultures you will experience.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you understand the culture better, you will appreciate its values more. (用 the better... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The better you understand the culture, the more you will appreciate its values.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: If you practice more, you will become more fluent. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more you practice, the more fluent you will become.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为“越……越……”结构。

exercises.q: The more you learn, the more you realize that the less you know.
exercises.answer: The more you learn, the more you realize how little you know.
exercises.explain: that 从句中应使用 how little 表达程度，而不是 the less。

exercises.q: The more languages you speak, the more opportunities you have to communicate with others.
exercises.answer: The more languages you speak, the more opportunities you have to communicate with others.
exercises.explain: 此句本身正确，无需修改；若必须改，可将 communicate 改为 interact 以增加词汇多样性。

exercises.q: The ______ you practice speaking English, the ______ your pronunciation will become.
exercises.explain: the+比较级, the+比较级 结构中两个分句都要用比较级形式。

exercises.q: ______ you sleep, ______ you will feel the next morning.
exercises.explain: 两个分句开头都需要 the 加比较级，表示“越……越……”。

exercises.q: The more friends you have, the ______ you will be.
exercises.explain: 后半句需要用比较级形式，happy 的比较级是 happier。

exercises.q: The ______ you walk, the sooner you will arrive.
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，结构要求用比较级。

exercises.q: The more you read, the ______ knowledge you gain.
exercises.explain: knowledge 是不可数名词，用 more 表示“更多的知识”。

exercises.q: The more you eat, the ______ (fat) you will get.
exercises.explain: fat 的比较级需要双写 t 再加 er。

exercises.q: The ______ (early) you get up, the more time you will have.
exercises.explain: early 的比较级是 earlier，结构要求用比较级。

exercises.q: The more careful you are, the ______ (few) mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: mistakes 是可数名词复数，few 的比较级是 fewer。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the best you become.
exercises.explain: 后半句应用比较级 better，而不是最高级 best。

exercises.q: The harder you work, the more successful you will be.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了 the+比较级结构。

exercises.q: If you study harder, you will get better grades. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The harder you study, the better grades you will get.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为 the+比较级, the+比较级 结构。

exercises.q: When you read more books, you learn more things. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more books you read, the more things you learn.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都改为 the more 引导的比较级结构。

exercises.q: If you get up early, you will have more time. (用 the earlier... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The earlier you get up, the more time you will have.
exercises.explain: early 变为比较级 earlier，后半句用 the more。

exercises.q: The more you exercise, the healthy you are.
exercises.answer: The more you exercise, the healthier you are.
exercises.explain: healthy 需要用比较级 healthier。

exercises.q: The more fast you run, the sooner you finish.
exercises.answer: The faster you run, the sooner you finish.
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，不能加 more。

exercises.q: The more languages a person learns, the ______ he or she can understand different cultures.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 understand 需要用副词 well 的比较级 better。

exercises.q: ______ you think about the problem, ______ the solution becomes.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都需要 the+比较级，clear 的比较级是 clearer。

exercises.q: The more time you spend with your family, the ______ you understand them.
exercises.explain: understand 是动词，需要用副词 well 的比较级 better 修饰。

exercises.q: The more you complain, the ______ people will want to listen to you.
exercises.explain: 此处表示程度递减，little 的比较级是 less。

exercises.q: The more independent you become, the ______ your parents will worry about you.
exercises.explain: worry 是不可数概念，用 less 表示“更少地”。

exercises.q: The more you share with others, the ______ (much) you will receive in return.
exercises.explain: much 的比较级是 more，表示“越多”。

exercises.q: The ______ (long) you stay in a foreign country, the more natural the language feels.
exercises.explain: long 的比较级是 longer，结构要求用比较级。

exercises.q: The more honest you are, the ______ (much) people will trust you.
exercises.explain: trust 是不可数概念，用 much 的比较级 more。

exercises.q: The more you worry about the exam, the less confident you become.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了 the+比较级结构，表示递减关系。

exercises.q: The more you practice speaking, the more fluently you can express yourself.
exercises.explain: fluently 是副词，more fluently 是正确比较级形式。

exercises.q: As you gain more experience, you become more confident. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more experience you gain, the more confident you become.
exercises.explain: 将 as 引导的时间状语从句转换为 the+比较级结构。

exercises.q: If you listen carefully, you will understand the lesson better. (用 the more... the better... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more carefully you listen, the better you will understand the lesson.
exercises.explain: carefully 变为比较级 more carefully，后半句用 the better。

exercises.q: When you have more responsibilities, you become more mature. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more responsibilities you have, the more mature you become.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都转换为 the more 引导的比较级结构。

exercises.q: The more you read, the more knowledge you will get, and the more wise you become.
exercises.answer: The more you read, the more knowledge you will get, and the wiser you become.
exercises.explain: wise 的比较级是 wiser，不能用 more wise。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the more better your skills become.
exercises.answer: The more you practice, the better your skills become.
exercises.explain: better 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The more deeply a person immerses himself in a foreign culture, the ______ he or she is to develop genuine cross-cultural understanding.
exercises.explain: likely 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more likely。

exercises.q: The more complex the problem becomes, the ______ it is to find a straightforward solution.
exercises.explain: hard 的比较级是 harder，结构要求用比较级。

exercises.q: The more you try to control every detail, the ______ likely you are to overlook the bigger picture.
exercises.explain: likely 前用 more 构成比较级，表示“越有可能”。

exercises.q: The more a society values education, the ______ its citizens tend to be in the long run.
exercises.explain: prosperous 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more prosperous。

exercises.q: The more you expose yourself to diverse perspectives, the ______ your own assumptions become.
exercises.explain: questionable 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more questionable。

exercises.q: The more you reflect on your mistakes, the ______ (valuable) the lessons you derive from them become.
exercises.explain: valuable 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more valuable。

exercises.q: The more frequently you engage in critical thinking, the ______ (sharp) your analytical skills will grow.
exercises.explain: sharp 的比较级是 sharper，结构要求用比较级。

exercises.q: The more you invest in meaningful relationships, the ______ (fulfilling) your life becomes.
exercises.explain: fulfilling 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more fulfilling。

exercises.q: The more a person is exposed to different cultures, the more tolerant he or she tends to become.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都正确使用了 the+比较级结构，表达递进关系。

exercises.q: The more you suppress your emotions, the more intensely they will eventually surface.
exercises.explain: intensely 是副词，more intensely 是正确比较级形式。

exercises.q: As you become more aware of your own biases, you become more capable of making fair judgments. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more aware you become of your own biases, the more capable you become of making fair judgments.
exercises.explain: 将 as 引导的从句转换为 the+比较级结构，保持原意。

exercises.q: If you approach challenges with a growth mindset, you will become more resilient. (用 the more... the more... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more you approach challenges with a growth mindset, the more resilient you will become.
exercises.explain: 将条件句转换为 the+比较级结构，resilient 前加 more。

exercises.q: When you take on more responsibilities, you develop greater leadership skills. (用 the more... the greater... 改写)
exercises.answer: The more responsibilities you take on, the greater leadership skills you develop.
exercises.explain: 两个分句都转换为 the+比较级结构，greater 修饰 leadership skills。

exercises.q: The more you procrastinate, the more stress you will accumulate, and the less productive you become.
exercises.answer: The more you procrastinate, the more stress you will accumulate, and the less productive you become.
exercises.explain: productive 的比较级是 less productive，原句正确，无需修改。

exercises.q: The more you ignore constructive criticism, the more harder it becomes to improve.
exercises.answer: The more you ignore constructive criticism, the harder it becomes to improve.
exercises.explain: harder 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense (with 'after' and Other Time Clauses)
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能是表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态。当它出现在 after 引导的时间状语从句中时，强调从句动作先于主句动作完成，并且这一完成状态与主句所描述的现在情况紧密相关。例如在“after they have gained enough knowledge”中，have gained 强调“获得知识”这一过程已经完成，为主句“stop learning”提供了时间背景和原因铺垫。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提到主语之前。在 after 从句中，主句可以用一般现在时、一般将来时或祈使句，但从句用现在完成时来强调动作的完成性。

与一般过去时的对比：after they gained knowledge 只陈述过去发生的动作，不强调与现在的关联；而 after they have gained knowledge 则突出“已经获得”这一完成状态对现在的影响。与 before、when、as soon as、once 等引导的时间状语从句类似，after 从句中也常用现在完成时来体现“先完成、后发生”的时间顺序。

初中阶段主要要求掌握现在完成时的基本构成和“已完成”与“未完成”两种用法，常与 already、yet、just、ever、never 等副词搭配。高中阶段则进一步要求在复杂句中使用现在完成时，尤其是在时间状语从句中与一般现在时、一般将来时配合，体现动作先后关系和语篇逻辑。同时，高中还需区分现在完成时与现在完成进行时、过去完成时的语用差异。

易错点一：在 after 引导的时间状语从句中误用一般将来时。英语中时间状语从句不用将来时，要用现在完成时或一般现在时代替将来完成时。易错点二：混淆 after 从句中一般过去时和现在完成时的语用区别——前者仅叙述过去，后者强调完成与关联。易错点三：主句为一般现在时时，从句用现在完成时容易让学生困惑，需明确这是为了突出动作的完成性而非时间上的“过去”。易错点四：不规则动词的过去分词形式掌握不牢，导致结构错误。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 其他）
否定式：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ 其他）
疑问式：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
after + 主语 + have/has + 过去分词, + 主句（一般现在时/一般将来时/祈使句）
主句 + after + 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
before/when/as soon as/once + 主语 + have/has + 过去分词, + 主句
notes: 在 after、before、when、as soon as、once 等引导的时间状语从句中，不能用 will 或 be going to，要用现在完成时或一般现在时代替将来完成时。
高考书面表达中，用 after + 现在完成时比 after + 一般过去时更能体现动作的完成性与逻辑衔接，是提升语篇连贯性的有效手段。
注意区分 after 从句中的现在完成时与主句中的一般现在时：前者表示先完成的动作，后者表示当前的状态或习惯，两者并不矛盾。
在正式书面语中，after having done 结构可以替代 after + 主语 + have/has done，但前者要求主从句主语一致，且语域更正式。
不规则动词的过去分词是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点，如 gain—gained—gained 是规则动词，但 stop—stopped—stopped 需双写辅音字母。

examples.en: After I have finished my homework, I can watch TV.
examples.cn: 我做完作业之后就可以看电视。

examples.en: She feels much better after she has taken the medicine.
examples.cn: 她吃了药之后感觉好多了。

examples.en: After they have gained enough knowledge in their mother tongue, many people stop learning.
examples.cn: 许多人在掌握了足够的母语知识后，就停止了学习。

examples.en: Once you have understood the rules, the game becomes quite simple.
examples.cn: 一旦你理解了规则，这个游戏就变得相当简单了。

examples.en: After the committee has reviewed all the applications, it will announce the final decision.
examples.cn: 委员会审查完所有申请后，将公布最终决定。

examples.en: Having acquired sufficient evidence, the researchers were able to draw a definitive conclusion.
examples.cn: 在获取了充分的证据之后，研究人员得以得出确切的结论。

exercises.q: I will call you after I ______ my homework.
exercises.explain: 在 after 引导的时间状语从句中，用一般现在时代替一般将来时。

exercises.q: She has ______ learned to ride a bike.
exercises.explain: just 常与现在完成时连用，表示“刚刚”。

exercises.q: After he ______ his breakfast, he goes to school.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数，用 has + 过去分词，表示在去学校前已经吃完早饭。

exercises.q: They ______ the film twice.
exercises.explain: twice 表示“两次”，常与现在完成时连用，主语 they 用 have。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his keys. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在有影响（开不了门），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have ______ (finish) my homework, so I can play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词。

exercises.q: After she ______ (read) the book, she returned it to the library.
exercises.explain: returned 是过去时，read 发生在 returned 之前，用过去完成时 had read。

exercises.q: He ______ (be) to Beijing three times.
exercises.explain: three times 表示经历，用现在完成时 has been。

exercises.q: After I will finish my homework, I will watch TV.
exercises.explain: after 引导的时间状语从句中不能用 will，应用一般现在时 finish。

exercises.q: She has lived here since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: I have finished my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I have not finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: He has gone to Shanghai. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She can swim. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.explain: can 表示能力时可与 be able to 互换，主语 she 用 is。

exercises.q: I have finish my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中 finish 要用过去分词 finished。

exercises.q: After he will arrive, we will start the meeting.
exercises.answer: After he arrives, we will start the meeting.
exercises.explain: after 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时代替一般将来时。

exercises.q: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: got 是过去时，电影开始发生在 got 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: After the guests ______, we began to have dinner.
exercises.explain: began 是过去时，客人到达在前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this school since she was seven.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语，表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在有影响（找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He said he ______ the book twice.
exercises.explain: said 是过去时，读书发生在 said 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: After he ______ (finish) his work, he went home.
exercises.explain: went 是过去时，完成工作在 went 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (not see) her parents for two years.
exercises.explain: for two years 表示持续一段时间，用现在完成时，否定加 not。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ (learn) 500 English words.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 表示到过去某时间为止，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: After he has finished his homework, he went out to play.
exercises.explain: 主句 went 是过去时，从句应用过去完成时 had finished。

exercises.q: I have known her for five years.
exercises.explain: for five years 表示持续一段时间，know 用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: She has already finished her homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She has not finished her homework yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定用 has not，already 在否定句中改为 yet。

exercises.q: They have been to London. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have 提到主语前。

exercises.q: He was able to solve the problem. (用 could 改写)
exercises.explain: be able to 表示过去能力时可与 could 互换。

exercises.q: After she has arrived, we started the meeting.
exercises.answer: After she had arrived, we started the meeting.
exercises.explain: started 是过去时，arrive 发生在 started 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I have bought this bike for three years.
exercises.answer: I have had this bike for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为延续性动词 have。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the station when the train left.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: After he ______ from university, he went abroad for further study.
exercises.explain: went 是过去时，毕业在前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 后接现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the time he arrives, we ______ all the preparations.
exercises.explain: by the time 表示将来某时间前完成，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in the company for ten years by next month.
exercises.explain: by next month 表示将来某时间前持续，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: No sooner ______ he ______ (arrive) than it began to rain.
exercises.explain: No sooner...than 句型中，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: After he ______ (be) in prison for five years, he was released.
exercises.explain: was released 是过去时，入狱五年在前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of this year, she ______ (write) three novels.
exercises.explain: by the end of this year 表示将来某时间前完成，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: After he had finished his speech, the audience applauded warmly.
exercises.explain: applauded 是过去时，完成演讲在前，用过去完成时正确。

exercises.q: It was the second time that she has visited the museum.
exercises.explain: It was the second time that 后应用过去完成时 had visited。

exercises.q: He has never been to Japan. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: He has never been to Japan, has he?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时反意疑问句，前句否定，后句用肯定 has he。

exercises.q: They have lived here since 2010. (对 since 2010 提问)
exercises.answer: How long have they lived here?
exercises.explain: 对 since 引导的时间状语提问用 How long。

exercises.q: After he had finished his homework, he went to bed. (用 not...until 改写)
exercises.answer: He did not go to bed until he had finished his homework.
exercises.explain: not...until 表示“直到……才”，需调整句子结构。

exercises.q: By the time he will arrive, we will have finished the work.
exercises.answer: By the time he arrives, we will have finished the work.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时代替一般将来时。

exercises.q: She has gone to Beijing three times.
exercises.answer: She has been to Beijing three times.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了未回”，has been to 表示“去过”，与 three times 搭配应用 has been to。

exercises.q: After he ______ his homework, he usually goes out to play basketball.
exercises.explain: 在 after 引导的时间状语从句中，用现在完成时强调动作在主句动作之前已经完成。

exercises.q: She feels much happier after she ______ the good news.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调“听到消息”这一动作已完成，并对现在的情绪产生了影响。

exercises.q: After the children ______ their hands, they sit down at the table.
exercises.explain: 用现在完成时强调洗手动作在坐下之前已经完成。

exercises.q: I can lend you the book after I ______ reading it.
exercises.explain: after 从句中用现在完成时表示“读完”这一动作先于主句“借书”完成。

exercises.q: After Tom ______ his teeth, he goes to bed every night.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调刷牙动作在睡觉前已经完成，是每晚的固定顺序。

exercises.q: After she ______ (finish) her dinner, she always takes a walk.
exercises.explain: after 引导的时间状语从句中，用现在完成时强调动作已完成。

exercises.q: You can watch TV after you ______ (do) your homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调作业完成在先，看电视在后。

exercises.q: After they ______ (clean) the classroom, they go home.
exercises.explain: 用现在完成时表示打扫动作在回家之前已经完成。

exercises.q: After he will finish his work, he will call you.
exercises.explain: 在 after 引导的时间状语从句中不能用将来时，应用现在完成时或一般现在时。

exercises.q: After she has read the letter, she smiled.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时，从句用现在完成时强调“读完信”先于“微笑”完成，结构正确。

exercises.q: After he finishes his homework, he goes out to play. (用现在完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After he has finished his homework, he goes out to play.
exercises.explain: 将一般现在时改为现在完成时，强调作业已完成。

exercises.q: She watches TV after she does the dishes. (用现在完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: She watches TV after she has done the dishes.
exercises.explain: after 从句用现在完成时强调洗碗动作先完成。

exercises.q: After they eat breakfast, they go to school. (用现在完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After they have eaten breakfast, they go to school.
exercises.explain: 用现在完成时强调吃早餐的动作在去学校前已完成。

exercises.q: After he will finish his homework, he will watch TV.
exercises.answer: After he has finished his homework, he will watch TV.
exercises.explain: 时间状语从句中不能用将来时，应改为现在完成时表示先完成作业。

exercises.q: After she has ate dinner, she goes for a walk.
exercises.answer: After she has eaten dinner, she goes for a walk.
exercises.explain: eat 的过去分词是 eaten，不是 ate。

exercises.q: After the guests ______, we started to clean the hall.
exercises.explain: 主句为一般过去时，after 从句用过去完成时强调“离开”先于“打扫”完成。

exercises.q: You shouldn't make a decision until you ______ all the facts.
exercises.explain: 在 until 引导的时间状语从句中，用现在完成时强调“了解事实”先于“做决定”完成。

exercises.q: After he ______ from university, he found a job in a bank.
exercises.explain: 主句为一般过去时，从句用过去完成时表示毕业发生在找工作之前。

exercises.q: I'll return the magazine to the library as soon as I ______ it.
exercises.explain: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句中用现在完成时强调“读完”先于“归还”完成。

exercises.q: After the teacher ______ the rules, the students began the exam.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时表示解释规则在考试开始前已完成。

exercises.q: After she ______ (save) enough money, she bought a new laptop.
exercises.explain: 主句为一般过去时，after 从句用过去完成时表示存钱先于购买完成。

exercises.q: You can go out to play after you ______ (complete) your project.
exercises.explain: after 从句中用现在完成时强调项目完成在先。

exercises.q: After the rain ______ (stop), we continued our journey.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时表示雨停发生在继续旅程之前。

exercises.q: After he has finished his speech, the audience applauded warmly.
exercises.explain: 主句为一般过去时，从句应用过去完成时 had finished 来保持时态一致。

exercises.q: After she had locked all the doors, she went to bed.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示锁门动作在睡觉前已完成，时态使用正确。

exercises.q: After he finished his work, he went home. (用过去完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After he had finished his work, he went home.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时强调工作先完成。

exercises.q: She will call you after she arrives at the airport. (用现在完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: She will call you after she has arrived at the airport.
exercises.explain: 在 after 从句中用现在完成时代替将来时，强调到达先于打电话。

exercises.q: After they ate dinner, they watched a movie. (用过去完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After they had eaten dinner, they watched a movie.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时强调吃晚饭先于看电影完成。

exercises.q: After he has graduated from college, he found a job in 2019.
exercises.answer: After he had graduated from college, he found a job in 2019.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时且有明确过去时间，从句应用过去完成时。

exercises.q: You can't leave until you will finish the test.
exercises.answer: You can't leave until you have finished the test.
exercises.explain: until 引导的时间状语从句中不能用将来时，应用现在完成时。

exercises.q: After the committee ______ the proposal, they decided to postpone the vote.
exercises.explain: 主句为一般过去时，从句用过去完成时表示审查提案在推迟投票之前已完成。

exercises.q: The scientist refused to publish her findings until she ______ sufficient evidence to support them.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，until 从句用过去完成时强调收集证据先于发表完成。

exercises.q: After the company ______ its new policy, employee satisfaction improved significantly.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示新政策实施在先，员工满意度提升在后。

exercises.q: Once the researchers ______ all the data, they will publish their conclusions.
exercises.explain: once 引导的时间状语从句中用现在完成时表示分析数据先于发表结论完成。

exercises.q: After the negotiations ______, both parties signed the agreement.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时表示谈判结束在签署协议之前。

exercises.q: After the jury ______ (reach) a verdict, the judge announced the sentence.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时表示陪审团达成裁决先于法官宣判。

exercises.q: The editor will review your article after you ______ (submit) the final draft.
exercises.explain: after 从句中用现在完成时表示提交终稿先于编辑审阅。

exercises.q: After the architect ______ (complete) the blueprint, construction began immediately.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示蓝图完成先于施工开始。

exercises.q: After the professor has reviewed the thesis, she provided detailed feedback.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句应用过去完成时 had reviewed 保持时态一致。

exercises.q: After the committee had deliberated for hours, they finally reached a consensus.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示审议在达成共识之前已完成，时态使用正确。

exercises.q: After the board approved the budget, the project was launched. (用过去完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After the board had approved the budget, the project was launched.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时强调预算批准先于项目启动。

exercises.q: The manager will announce the results after she consults with the team. (用现在完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: The manager will announce the results after she has consulted with the team.
exercises.explain: after 从句中用现在完成时表示咨询团队先于宣布结果完成。

exercises.q: After the software developers fixed the bug, the system ran smoothly. (用过去完成时改写 after 从句)
exercises.answer: After the software developers had fixed the bug, the system ran smoothly.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时强调修复漏洞先于系统正常运行。

exercises.q: After the committee has reached a decision, they announced it to the public.
exercises.answer: After the committee had reached a decision, they announced it to the public.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，从句应用过去完成时 had reached 保持时态一致。

exercises.q: The results will be published after the peer review will be completed.
exercises.answer: The results will be published after the peer review has been completed.
exercises.explain: after 引导的时间状语从句中不能用将来时，应用现在完成时的被动语态。

grammar.title: nor 引起的部分倒装（含 neither / so 对比与高中拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Inversion with 'nor' (including neither / so and senior-level extensions)
grammar.usage:
核心结构：当 nor 用于引出另一个否定陈述，表示“也不……”，且该句主语与前句主语不同时，nor 后面的句子必须使用部分倒装，即把助动词、be 动词或情态动词提到主语之前。基本结构为：Nor + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 其他成分。nor 本身已经含有否定意义，因此句中不再使用 not。

肯定、否定与疑问：nor 引导的倒装句本身表达否定含义，通常不单独构成一般疑问句，而是作为并列否定陈述的第二部分出现。前句可以是否定句，也可以是含有 few、little、never、hardly、seldom 等半否定或否定副词的句子。若前句为肯定句，则不能用 nor，而应用 so 引导倒装表示“也……”。

与近义结构对比：nor 与 neither 在引导倒装句时意义基本相同，都表示“也不”。区别在于：nor 更常见于连接两个分句，前句往往是否定句；neither 可单独用于句首，也可与 nor 搭配构成 neither...nor... 结构。so 则用于肯定句后的“也……”倒装，与 nor/neither 形成对称。高中阶段还需注意 nor 可用于“否定句 + nor + 倒装句”的并列结构中，且 nor 前可用逗号或分号。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要要求掌握“前句否定 + nor/neither + 倒装”的基本公式，能完成句型转换和语法填空。高中阶段则进一步要求：1）识别前句中 few、little、never、hardly、seldom、rarely、by no means 等隐性否定词，并正确使用 nor 倒装；2）在书面表达中主动使用 nor 倒装增强句式多样性；3）区分 nor 倒装与 so 倒装、neither...nor... 并列结构、not...nor... 等变体；4）注意 nor 引导倒装时助动词的时态、情态动词的选择须与前句呼应。

易错点：1）前句虽无 not，但含 few、little、never 等否定意义词时，后句仍可用 nor 倒装，不能误判为肯定句而改用 so。2）nor 引导的倒装句中不能再加 not，否则造成双重否定。3）nor 倒装时助动词或 be 动词的时态要与前句保持一致，不能随意更换时态。4）前句主语与后句主语不同时才用 nor 倒装；若前后主语相同，通常用 neither 或 not...either 表达，如“He didn't go, and he didn't want to go either.”而非 nor 倒装。
forms: Nor + be动词 + 主语 + 其他成分
Nor + 助动词(do/does/did/have/has/had) + 主语 + 动词原形/过去分词 + 其他成分
Nor + 情态动词(can/could/will/would/may/might/must) + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他成分
否定句 + ; nor + 倒装句
否定句 + . Neither + 倒装句（与 nor 倒装可互换）
前句含 few/little/never/hardly/seldom 等否定词 + , nor + 倒装句
notes: nor 本身已含否定意义，倒装句中不能再出现 not、never 等否定词，否则会造成双重否定，逻辑错误。
高考书面表达中，nor 倒装属于高级句式，但不可滥用。通常用于与前句形成并列否定关系，且前后主语不同时使用，否则显得生硬。
注意语域：nor 倒装多用于正式书面语和论述性文本，口语中更常用 neither 或 not...either。高考作文中适当使用可提升语言档次，但需确保前句确为否定意义。
前句若含 few、little、seldom、hardly、rarely、by no means 等隐性否定词，后句用 nor 倒装是正确的，不要因为前句没有 not 就误用 so。
nor 倒装句中助动词或 be 动词的时态、人称和数必须与前句保持一致，否则会被视为语法错误。

examples.en: I don't like coffee, nor does my sister.
examples.cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，我妹妹也不喜欢。

examples.en: She can't swim, nor can her brother.
examples.cn: 她不会游泳，她哥哥也不会。

examples.en: He didn't finish his homework, nor did he hand it in on time.
examples.cn: 他没有完成作业，也没有按时上交。

examples.en: There were few online classes available then, nor was there easy access to required information.
examples.cn: 那时几乎没有在线课程可用，也没有便捷的途径获取所需信息。

examples.en: The company rarely invests in new technology, nor does it show any interest in staff training.
examples.cn: 这家公司很少投资新技术，对员工培训也毫无兴趣。

examples.en: By no means should we ignore the environmental impact, nor can we afford to delay taking action.
examples.cn: 我们绝不应忽视环境影响，也承担不起拖延采取行动的后果。

exercises.q: I don't like coffee, and ______ my sister.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般现在时否定句，主语是第三人称单数 my sister，需用助动词 does 倒装。

exercises.q: He can't swim, and ______ I.
exercises.explain: 前句有情态动词 can 的否定形式，nor 后用 can 倒装，且不再重复否定。

exercises.q: She wasn't at home yesterday, and ______ her brother.
exercises.explain: 前句为 be 动词过去式否定，nor 后用 was 倒装。

exercises.q: Tom doesn't eat meat, and ______ his parents.
exercises.explain: 主语 his parents 是复数，前句为一般现在时否定，用 do 倒装。

exercises.q: They weren't tired, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: 前句为 be 动词过去式复数否定，nor 后用 were 倒装。

exercises.q: I don't have a bike, and ______ does my brother.
exercises.explain: nor 用于引出另一个否定陈述，表示"也不"。

exercises.q: She can't dance, and nor ______ he.
exercises.explain: 前句有情态动词 can，nor 后需用 can 倒装。

exercises.q: He wasn't late, and nor ______ I.
exercises.explain: 前句为 be 动词过去式否定，nor 后用 was 倒装。

exercises.q: I don't like tea, and nor does my friend.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般现在时否定，主语 my friend 是第三人称单数，用 does 倒装正确。

exercises.q: She can't swim, and nor can't I.
exercises.explain: nor 本身已含否定意义，后面不能再加 not 或使用否定缩写。

exercises.q: I don't like apples. My sister doesn't like apples, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: I don't like apples, and nor does my sister.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，后句需倒装，主语 my sister 用 does。

exercises.q: He can't play the piano. I can't play the piano, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: He can't play the piano, and nor can I.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，情态动词 can 提前倒装。

exercises.q: They weren't at school. We weren't at school, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: They weren't at school, and nor were we.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，be 动词 were 提前倒装。

exercises.q: I don't like math, and nor I do.
exercises.answer: I don't like math, and nor do I.
exercises.explain: nor 后面的句子需要倒装，助动词 do 应放在主语 I 之前。

exercises.q: She wasn't happy, and nor there was her friend.
exercises.answer: She wasn't happy, and nor was her friend.
exercises.explain: nor 后面的句子需要倒装，be 动词 was 应放在主语 her friend 之前。

exercises.q: He has never been to Beijing, and ______ his wife.
exercises.explain: 前句为现在完成时否定，主语 his wife 是第三人称单数，用 has 倒装。

exercises.q: They didn't finish the work, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: She won't go to the party, and ______ I.
exercises.explain: 前句有 will 的否定形式，nor 后用 will 倒装。

exercises.q: My father doesn't smoke, and ______ my uncle.
exercises.explain: 主语 my uncle 是第三人称单数，前句为一般现在时否定，用 does 倒装。

exercises.q: The students weren't interested in the film, and ______ the teacher.
exercises.explain: 主语 the teacher 是单数，前句为 be 动词过去式否定，用 was 倒装。

exercises.q: He didn't call me, and nor ______ he text me.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般过去时否定，nor 后用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: She has never visited Shanghai, and nor ______ her parents.
exercises.explain: 主语 her parents 是复数，前句为现在完成时否定，用 have 倒装。

exercises.q: I won't be late, and nor ______ my brother.
exercises.explain: 前句有 will 的否定形式，nor 后用 will 倒装。

exercises.q: He didn't go to the park, and nor did I.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般过去时否定，nor 后用 did 倒装，结构正确。

exercises.q: She has never eaten sushi, and nor has her friends.
exercises.explain: 主语 her friends 是复数，应该用 have 而不是 has。

exercises.q: He didn't pass the exam. I didn't pass the exam, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: He didn't pass the exam, and nor did I.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，前句为一般过去时，用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: She has never been abroad. Her sister has never been abroad, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: She has never been abroad, and nor has her sister.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，主语 her sister 是第三人称单数，用 has 倒装。

exercises.q: They won't accept the offer. We won't accept the offer, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: They won't accept the offer, and nor will we.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，前句有 will，nor 后用 will 倒装。

exercises.q: He didn't come to class, and nor he did finish his homework.
exercises.answer: He didn't come to class, and nor did he finish his homework.
exercises.explain: nor 后面的句子需要倒装，助动词 did 应放在主语 he 之前。

exercises.q: She has never tried skiing, and nor has never her brother.
exercises.answer: She has never tried skiing, and nor has her brother.
exercises.explain: nor 本身已含否定意义，不能再用 never，且需倒装。

exercises.q: The company didn't meet its sales target last quarter, nor ______ any significant progress in market expansion.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 提前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She has never complained about the working conditions, nor ______ any intention of leaving.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为现在完成时，用 has 提前，后接过去分词。

exercises.q: The government didn't provide sufficient funding for the project, nor ______ any clear guidelines for its implementation.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 提前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: He couldn't solve the problem by himself, nor ______ anyone else in the team.
exercises.explain: 前句有情态动词 could 的否定形式，nor 后用 could 倒装，且不再重复否定。

exercises.q: The old system wasn't efficient, nor ______ cost-effective.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为 be 动词过去式否定，用 was 提前。

exercises.q: The committee didn't approve the budget, nor ______ it consider the alternative proposal.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般过去时否定，nor 后用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: He has never acknowledged his mistake, nor ______ he apologized to those affected.
exercises.explain: 前句为现在完成时否定，nor 后用 has 倒装。

exercises.q: The evidence wasn't conclusive, nor ______ the witness testimony reliable.
exercises.explain: 前句为 be 动词过去式否定，nor 后用 was 倒装。

exercises.q: The report didn't address the key issues, nor did it provide any practical recommendations.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 提前，结构正确。

exercises.q: She has never been to Europe, nor has her colleagues.
exercises.explain: 主语 her colleagues 是复数，应该用 have 而不是 has。

exercises.q: The manager didn't attend the meeting. The assistant didn't attend the meeting, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: The manager didn't attend the meeting, nor did the assistant.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，前句为一般过去时，用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: The policy hasn't achieved its goals. It hasn't gained public support, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: The policy hasn't achieved its goals, nor has it gained public support.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，前句为现在完成时，用 has 倒装。

exercises.q: The students couldn't understand the theory. The teacher couldn't explain it clearly, either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: The students couldn't understand the theory, nor could the teacher explain it clearly.
exercises.explain: 用 nor 连接两个否定句，前句有情态动词 could，nor 后用 could 倒装。

exercises.q: The company didn't invest in new technology, nor it did train its employees properly.
exercises.answer: The company didn't invest in new technology, nor did it train its employees properly.
exercises.explain: nor 后面的句子需要倒装，助动词 did 应放在主语 it 之前。

exercises.q: He has never admitted his fault, nor has he never offered a sincere apology.
exercises.answer: He has never admitted his fault, nor has he offered a sincere apology.
exercises.explain: nor 本身已含否定意义，不能再用 never，且需保持倒装结构。

exercises.q: He didn't go to the party, and ______ his sister.
exercises.explain: 前句为否定句，nor 引出另一个否定陈述时需部分倒装，助动词 did 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She can't swim, and ______ her brother.
exercises.explain: nor 表示“也不”，后接情态动词 can 并倒装，且不再重复否定词。

exercises.q: I have never been to Beijing, and ______ my parents.
exercises.explain: 前句含否定词 never，nor 后用 have 倒装表示“我父母也没去过”。

exercises.q: They weren't tired, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: nor 引出否定倒装句，be 动词 were 提到主语 we 之前。

exercises.q: Tom doesn't like coffee, and ______ his friend.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般现在时否定句，nor 后用 does 构成倒装。

exercises.q: She didn't finish her homework, and ______ did her classmate.
exercises.explain: nor 用于引出另一个否定陈述，且后接倒装语序。

exercises.q: He isn't interested in music, nor ______ his sister.
exercises.explain: nor 后需倒装，be 动词 is 提到主语 his sister 之前。

exercises.q: They couldn't solve the problem, nor ______ we.
exercises.explain: nor 引出倒装句，情态动词 could 提前。

exercises.q: He didn't call me, nor did he write to me.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 did 倒装，表示“也没有写信”，结构正确。

exercises.q: She wasn't at home, nor there was her mother.
exercises.explain: nor 后应倒装为 nor was there her mother，而非 nor there was。

exercises.q: He didn't go to the park. His brother didn't go to the park either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: He didn't go to the park, nor did his brother.
exercises.explain: nor 连接两个否定句，后句需部分倒装。

exercises.q: I can't speak French. My sister can't speak French either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: I can't speak French, nor can my sister.
exercises.explain: nor 后接情态动词 can 并倒装，表示“也不会”。

exercises.q: They weren't late. We weren't late either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: They weren't late, nor were we.
exercises.explain: nor 引出倒装句，be 动词 were 提前。

exercises.q: He didn't eat breakfast, nor he didn't drink milk.
exercises.answer: He didn't eat breakfast, nor did he drink milk.
exercises.explain: nor 后需倒装且不再重复否定词，应改为 nor did he drink milk。

exercises.q: She can't dance, nor can't she sing.
exercises.answer: She can't dance, nor can she sing.
exercises.explain: nor 本身已含否定意义，后句不能再加 not。

exercises.q: The students hadn't prepared for the exam, and ______ the teacher.
exercises.explain: 前句为过去完成时否定句，nor 后用 had 倒装表示“老师也没有”。

exercises.q: My brother won't attend the meeting, and ______ my sister.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 will 并倒装，表示“我妹妹也不会参加”。

exercises.q: He had never seen such a beautiful sunset, and ______ his wife.
exercises.explain: 前句含否定词 never，nor 后用 had 倒装表示“他妻子也没见过”。

exercises.q: She doesn't enjoy horror movies, and ______ her best friend.
exercises.explain: nor 引出倒装句，助动词 does 提前，表示“她最好的朋友也不喜欢”。

exercises.q: The children weren't allowed to go out alone, and ______ their cousins.
exercises.explain: nor 后 be 动词 were 倒装，表示“他们的表亲也不被允许”。

exercises.q: He didn't realize the danger, nor ______ he care about the consequences.
exercises.explain: nor 后需倒装，助动词 did 提前，表示“也不在乎后果”。

exercises.q: The manager wasn't satisfied with the report, nor ______ the director.
exercises.explain: nor 引出倒装句，be 动词 was 提到主语 the director 之前。

exercises.q: They hadn't been informed of the change, nor ______ they been given any explanation.
exercises.explain: nor 后接过去完成时倒装，had 提前表示“也没有得到解释”。

exercises.q: She couldn't remember his name, nor could she recall where they had met.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 could 倒装，表示“也想不起来在哪里见过”，结构正确。

exercises.q: He didn't apologize, nor he did explain his behavior.
exercises.explain: nor 后应倒装为 nor did he explain，而非 nor he did explain。

exercises.q: She didn't accept the offer. Her colleague didn't accept the offer either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: She didn't accept the offer, nor did her colleague.
exercises.explain: nor 连接两个否定句，后句用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: They haven't visited the new museum. We haven't visited it either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: They haven't visited the new museum, nor have we.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 have 倒装，表示“我们也没参观过”。

exercises.q: He won't change his mind. His partner won't change her mind either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: He won't change his mind, nor will his partner.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 will 倒装，表示“他的搭档也不会改变主意”。

exercises.q: The students didn't understand the question, nor the teacher didn't understand it.
exercises.answer: The students didn't understand the question, nor did the teacher understand it.
exercises.explain: nor 后需倒装且不再重复否定词，应改为 nor did the teacher understand it。

exercises.q: She hadn't read the novel, nor hadn't she seen the film.
exercises.answer: She hadn't read the novel, nor had she seen the film.
exercises.explain: nor 本身含否定意义，后句不能再加 not。

exercises.q: The committee had not reached a consensus on the proposal, ______ the stakeholders been consulted about its potential impact.
exercises.explain: nor 后接过去完成时倒装，had 提前，表示“利益相关者也没有被咨询”。

exercises.q: Under no circumstances ______ the confidential data be shared with unauthorized personnel, nor should it be stored on personal devices.
exercises.explain: nor 前已有否定状语，nor 后接 should 倒装，表示“也不应存储在个人设备上”。

exercises.q: The theory doesn't adequately explain the observed phenomenon, ______ does it account for the anomalies in the data.
exercises.explain: nor 引出另一个否定陈述，后接 does 倒装，表示“也不能解释数据异常”。

exercises.q: He had never questioned the validity of the research, ______ had he considered the possibility of bias in the methodology.
exercises.explain: 前句含 never，nor 后接 had 倒装，表示“也没有考虑过方法论中的偏见”。

exercises.q: The new policy won't alleviate the housing crisis, ______ will it address the underlying economic inequalities.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 will 倒装，表示“也不会解决根本的经济不平等”。

exercises.q: The scientist didn't anticipate such a dramatic result, nor ______ she expect the findings to be so controversial.
exercises.explain: nor 后需倒装，助动词 did 提前，表示“也没预料到研究结果如此有争议”。

exercises.q: The novel isn't merely a love story, nor ______ it simply a critique of social norms.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 be 动词 is 倒装，表示“也不仅仅是对社会规范的批判”。

exercises.q: He hadn't been informed of the risks involved, nor ______ he been given the opportunity to withdraw his consent.
exercises.explain: nor 后接过去完成时倒装，had 提前，表示“也没有机会撤回同意”。

exercises.q: The evidence doesn't support the hypothesis, nor does it invalidate the alternative explanation.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 does 倒装，表示“也不能否定另一种解释”，结构正确。

exercises.q: He didn't submit the report on time, nor he did notify his supervisor of the delay.
exercises.explain: nor 后应倒装为 nor did he notify，而非 nor he did notify。

exercises.q: The government didn't implement the recommended reforms. It didn't allocate sufficient funding for them either. (用 nor 合并)
exercises.answer: The government didn't implement the recommended reforms, nor did it allocate sufficient funding for them.
exercises.explain: nor 连接两个否定句，后句用 did 倒装，表示“也没有分配足够资金”。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Condition with 'as long as' / 由 'as long as' 引导的条件状语从句
grammar.title: 由 as long as 引导的条件状语从句（含 if / unless / provided that 对比）
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clause of Condition with 'as long as' (vs. if / unless / provided that)
grammar.usage:
“as long as” 是一个从属连词，用来引导条件状语从句，核心含义是“只要”，表示主句成立所依赖的充分条件。它的基本结构是：As long as + 条件从句, + 主句。条件从句可以放在主句之前，也可以放在主句之后；放在句首时，从句后通常加逗号。

在肯定句中，“as long as” 强调“只要满足这个条件，结果就会成立”。例如：As long as you keep practising, you will improve. 在否定句中，否定词可以出现在主句或从句中，但要注意语义差别：主句否定表示“只要……就不……”，从句否定表示“只要不……就……”。疑问句中，“as long as” 通常出现在主句为疑问形式的结构里，例如：Can I use the lab as long as I sign in? 此时它仍表示条件，而非时间。

“as long as” 与 “if” 都表示条件，但 “if” 更中性、更宽泛，而 “as long as” 更强调条件的充分性和说话人的主观期待，语气更强。“unless” 表示“除非”，相当于 “if...not”，与 “as long as” 形成条件正反对比。“provided that” 和 “on condition that” 更正式，多用于书面语或法律、商务语境，而 “as long as” 在口语和书面语中都常见。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 “as long as” 的基本含义“只要”，并能与 “if” 做简单替换。高中阶段则要求进一步理解它在真实语境中的语用功能，比如表达承诺、限制、警告或鼓励，同时要能区分它与 “as long as” 表时间“长达……”的用法。高中写作中，使用 “as long as” 替代单一的 “if” 可以增强逻辑性和语气。

易错点一：把 “as long as” 误认为时间状语“长达……之久”。判断方法是看前后句之间是否存在“条件—结果”关系。易错点二：在条件从句中使用一般将来时。英语中，条件状语从句通常用一般现在时表示将来，即使主句是 will 结构。易错点三：混淆 “as long as” 与 “as far as”。“as far as” 表示“就……而言”，不引导条件。易错点四：在正式书面语中过度使用 “as long as”，忽略 “provided that” 等更正式的替换表达。
forms: As long as + 主语 + 一般现在时, + 主句（一般现在时/一般将来时/祈使句）
主句 + as long as + 主语 + 一般现在时
As long as + 主语 + 一般现在时（否定式）, + 主句
主句（否定式） + as long as + 主语 + 一般现在时
As long as + 从句, + 主句 = Provided that + 从句, + 主句（更正式）
As long as + 从句, + 主句 ≠ As long as + 时间段（表“长达……”）
notes: 高考书面语中，若想表达更正式的条件，可考虑用 provided that 或 on condition that 替换 as long as，但要注意语域匹配。
在条件状语从句中，即使主句用 will 表示将来，从句也要用一般现在时，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
“as long as” 引导条件时，不能与 “so long as” 在正式写作中随意互换——两者意思相近，但 “so long as” 更口语化，高考书面表达建议优先使用 “as long as”。
注意区分 “as long as” 表条件与表时间：表时间时后面常接时间段，如 as long as three hours，此时主句不表示“条件—结果”关系。
在阅读理解中，遇到 “as long as” 时要结合上下文判断是“只要”还是“长达”，避免因词义误判导致逻辑理解错误。

grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基本用法到与不定式的语用分工
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Core Usage and Gerund–Infinitive Contrast
grammar.usage: 动名词是动词的 -ing 形式，在句中起名词作用，可以充当主语。其核心结构为“动名词短语 + 单数谓语 + 其他成分”，例如：Knowing a language helps you express yourself. 动名词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数，因为整个动名词短语被视作一个抽象的单数概念。肯定句直接以动名词短语开头；否定句在动名词前加 not，如 Not asking for help is sometimes a mistake. 疑问句可借助 it 作形式主语构成，如 Is learning grammar important?，也可用 wh-疑问词引导，如 What causes stress? — Waiting too long. 动名词作主语通常表示一般性、习惯性或抽象的动作，强调行为本身；而不定式作主语往往表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作，且常与特定条件或目的相关。初中阶段主要要求识别“动名词开头 + 单数谓语”的句型，并能正确判断主谓一致；高中阶段则进一步要求区分动名词与不定式作主语的语用差异，掌握 it 作形式主语的正式表达，理解动名词短语作主语在书面语、议论文和谚语中的高频使用，并能将动词短语名词化以提升表达的抽象性和正式度。易错点包括：把动名词误认为进行时谓语；谓语忘记用单数；在需要表达具体、一次性动作时误用动名词；以及动名词短语较长时不会用 it 作形式主语进行句式调整。
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语 + 宾语/表语：Learning a foreign language takes time.
否定：Not + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语：Not asking for help can make things worse.
It + 单数谓语 + 动名词短语（形式主语结构）：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
动名词短语 + is + 形容词/名词（表评价）：Reading widely is essential for writing well.
There is no + 动名词短语（固定句型）：There is no denying the importance of practice.
动名词作主语 vs 不定式作主语：Swimming is good exercise.（泛指） / To swim in this river is dangerous today.（具体）
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词，如 Making mistakes is part of learning.
不要把句首的 -ing 形式误判为进行时谓语。判断标准：句首 -ing 短语后是否紧跟 be 动词；若直接跟实义动词或系动词，则 -ing 短语是主语。
高考书面语中，动名词作主语比不定式更常见于议论文和说明文，能增强表达的抽象性和客观性；不定式作主语则多用于具体情境或表达目的。
当动名词短语较长时，正式语域常用 it 作形式主语，将真正的主语后置，如 It is worthwhile reflecting on your mistakes. 注意不要写成 It is worthwhile to reflect... 与动名词结构混用。
部分固定句型只用动名词作主语，如 There is no point (in) doing... / It is no use doing... / It is worth doing...，这些在高考语法填空和写作中属于高频考点。
